params.1273: Harvest a crop of marrentill from a herb patch.
params.1274: You can pickpocket marrentill from Master Farmers (with sufficient Thieving), buy them, or play Vinesweeper for them.
params.1275: Head to a herb patch to plant them.
params.1276: Once cleaned, herbs are the core of the Herblore skill. Marrentill is also used in Prayer to light incense burners.
